short.zh: 把两个数汇进一个元件
short.en: Merge two numbers in one component

t.zh: 回到棋盘城市：街道只能往右或往下走，每个路口的路线数 = 上面 + 左边。这一次，左上角的起点已经替你写好了 1，剩下的路口交给机器人。
t.en: Back to the grid city: streets only go right or down, and routes to each crossing = up + left. This time the start in the top-left corner already holds a 1 for you, and the robot takes care of the other crossings.

t.zh: 一根线只能送一个数。要把上面和左边加在一起，需要一个元件：汇合器。它顶上有三个输入圆点，把接进来的数加起来，从底部的圆点送出去。
t.en: A wire carries just one number. To add up and left together you need a component: the Merger. It has three input dots on top; it adds up whatever is wired in and sends the result out of the dot at its bottom.

t.zh: 第一行的格子，上面没有格子，视野里显示「界外」，送来的是「—」，意思是「这里没有路」。汇合器会跳过「—」，只加真正的数。
t.en: For cells in the top row there is no cell above: the view shows “out”, and what comes in is “—”, meaning “there is no road here”. The Merger skips “—” and adds up only real numbers.

t.zh: 怎么放元件：把电路板下面托盘里的汇合器，拖到电路板的空格上（点一下也行）。按住它可以拖到别的格子，拖回托盘就拿掉了。
t.en: Placing a component: drag the Merger from the tray under the board onto an empty slot of the board (a click works too). Hold it to drag it to another slot; drag it back to the tray to remove it.

goal.zh: 街道只能往右或往下走，起点已经写好 1。让机器人算出每个路口的路线数：每个路口 = 上面 + 左边。
goal.en: Streets only go right or down, and the start already holds 1. Have the robot work out the number of routes to every crossing: each crossing = up + left.

how.zh: 在视野里点「上面」和「左边」两格，再放一个汇合器，把视野元件的两个输出口接进去，再把汇合器接到「本格」。
how.en: Click the “up” and “left” cells in the view, place a Merger, wire both outputs of the View part into it, then wire the Merger to “this cell”.

say.zh: 第 1 步：在视野里点「上面」和「左边」，「视野」元件就有了两个输出口。
say.en: Step 1: click “up” and “left” in the view: the “View” part then has two outputs.

say.zh: 第 2 步：把托盘里的<part-ref to="part:msum"></part-ref>拖到电路板的空格上，点一下也行。
say.en: Step 2: drag the <part-ref to="part:msum"></part-ref> from the tray onto an empty slot of the board, or just click it.

say.zh: 第 3 步：把视野的两个输出口各接到汇合器左边的一个圆点，再把汇合器右边的圆点接到「本格」。
say.en: Step 3: wire each of the View’s two outputs into a dot on the Merger’s left, then wire the Merger’s right-hand dot to “this cell”.

hints.zh: 每个路口 = 上面 + 左边：两个输入都接进同一个汇合器，汇合器再接到「本格」。
hints.en: Each crossing = up + left: wire both inputs into the same Merger, and the Merger into “this cell”.

body.zh: 之前你亲手填了 12 个路口；现在你只接了三根线，机器人就把整座城市填满了。
body.en: Before, you filled in 12 crossings by hand; now you drew three wires and the robot filled in the whole city.

body.zh: 起点那个 1，是替机器人写好的。
body.en: The 1 at the start was written in for the robot.

note.zh: 汇合器把几根线送来的数加起来，「—」不参与。
note.en: A Merger adds up the numbers its wires bring; “—” is left out.
